items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Terminology 35:1
items.html: The aspect of the anterior of AVI, meaning above their Chazeh [chest], where the aspect of the restriction of the bottom Hey does not govern, is in the filling of Yods, both in Abba and in Ima. For even in Ima the source of the bottom Hey in the Einayim begins only in her lower third, which receives from the phase corresponding to it, from the lower third of SAG of AK, for there is the beginning of the rooting of the bottom Hey in the Einayim, as is known. And you already know that the filling of Yods indicates the aspect of the first restriction, before the bottom Hey joined with the first Hey, and that the filling of Alephs indicates the Malchut of the second restriction, which is sweetened in the first Hey. Therefore the anterior of AVI are HaVaYaH and Ehyeh of the filling of Yods, to indicate that there is as yet no beginning there of the filling of Alephs, which is the secret of the bottom Hey being partnered with the first Hey, as is known. And this is the secret of their numerical value, which is Zachor [זכור, remember], for by their illumination the fallen AHP are remembered and are returned to their degree. (Page 897, Item 48).
